incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired - queue_backlog_high for inference-cell-prod - queue length > 5k, avg latency > 1s, autoscaler behind. link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/INC12345
pagerduty: Page triggered for escalation policy 'inference-oncall' — on-call: @sam_oncall
sam_oncall: acked :white_check_mark: I'm on it. Brief status? Any known customer impact?
incident-bot: Customer Impact: ~5% errors (502/504) observed on /v1/generate; tail latencies >1s; queue length 5200 and rising. Pods Pending due to node capacity.
priya: copy. Can you paste HPA + pod status? Suspect nodepool quota or OOM eviction loop.
sam_oncall: running: kubectl -n inference get hpa,deployment,pods --selector=app=inference-worker
sam_oncall: ```
HPA inference-worker   min:2 max:50   desired:20   current:18
DEP inference-worker   replicas:18   available:12
PODS: 6 Pending, 12 Running
Events: 6x FailedScheduling "0/100 nodes available: insufficient memory"
```
sam_oncall: HPA attempting to scale to 20 but 6 pods Pending with FailedScheduling (insufficient memory). Nodepool at max size.
jon_sre: checking cloud quotas now — nodepool at 100 nodes (max). Spot capacity exhausted in us-west1. Opening a quota request and preparing manual resize.
sam_oncall: manual actions: 1) scale nodepool up, 2) temporarily scale deployment. Running: `gcloud container clusters resize inference-cluster --node-pool=inference-pool --num-nodes=120 --zone=us-west1-b`
sam_oncall: and: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=40` to help drain backlog quickly.
product_ops: FYI — notifying CS and affected customers that we have a degrading service for inference API. Routing temporary to smaller model for high-volume customers.
priya: applying routing patch to prioritize small-quant model for non-enterprise traffic (reduces per-request memory/cpu).
jon_sre: cloud approved temporary +30 nodes. Spot pool recovering. Starting NodePool enlargement now.
sam_oncall: new nodes registering, pods scheduling. Queue length dropping 5200 -> 3400 -> 1200 over next few minutes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by sam_oncall; escalation paused. If unresolved in 15m will escalate.
sam_oncall: monitoring: error rate falling, tail p50/p95 latencies decreasing. Will scale down once stable to avoid excess cost.
sam_oncall: scaling deployment back to steady state: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=22`
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident INC12345 resolved by sam_oncall — page closed.
product_ops: noted for retro. Will set follow-up action: add buffer to nodepool autoscaling policy and increase quota pre-emptively for us-west1.
